# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On January 27, 2025, subsidiaries of Global Clean Energy Holdings, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 19 to their senior secured term loan credit agreement.
- The Borrower is BKRF OCB, LLC, with BKRF OCP, LLC and Bakersfield Renewable Fuels, LLC as additional parties. Orion Energy Partners TP Agent, LLC serves as the Administrative Agent.
- This amendment provides an upsizing of Tranche D commitments under the Senior Credit Agreement of up to $334,550,000, with any unfunded portion automatically terminating on February 7, 2025 (or later date as consented by the Administrative Agent).
- In consideration for the upsize, $40,000,000 of existing Tranche A, Tranche B, and Tranche C loans will be recharacterized as Tranche C+ loans with a minimum return of 1.35x.
- Global Clean Energy Holdings, Inc. is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Bakersfield, California, operating in the clean energy sector with renewable fuels operations.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• The ability to secure additional financing through an upsize demonstrates continued lender confidence and market access
• The recharacterization structure with minimum return provisions (1.35x) suggests structured risk mitigation for lenders
• Orion Energy Partners involvement as Administrative Agent indicates institutional backing from an experienced energy-focused investment firm

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• The automatic termination clause (February 7, 2025) creates time pressure for utilization of the unfunded commitment
• This represents the 19th amendment to the credit agreement, potentially indicating ongoing refinancing needs or covenant management issues
• Limited information available on pricing, maturity, or detailed covenant structure constrains full credit assessment
• Clean energy sector exposure may involve regulatory and commodity price risks

Definitions
• A contradiction = two statements or claims that cannot both be true.
• Examples of contradictions:

# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On January 27, 2025, subsidiaries of Global Clean Energy Holdings, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 19 to their senior secured term loan credit agreement.
- The Borrower is BKRF OCB, LLC, with BKRF OCP, LLC and Bakersfield Renewable Fuels, LLC as additional parties. Orion Energy Partners TP Agent, LLC serves as the Administrative Agent.
- This amendment provides an upsizing of Tranche D commitments under the Senior Credit Agreement of up to $334,550,000, with any unfunded portion automatically terminating on February 7, 2025 (or later date as consented by the Administrative Agent).
- In consideration for the upsize, $40,000,000 of existing Tranche A, Tranche B, and Tranche C loans will be recharacterized as Tranche C+ loans with a minimum return of 1.35x.
- Global Clean Energy Holdings, Inc. is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Bakersfield, California, operating in the clean energy sector with renewable fuels operations.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• The ability to secure additional financing through an upsize demonstrates continued lender confidence and market access
• The recharacterization structure with minimum return provisions (1.35x) suggests structured risk mitigation for lenders
• Orion Energy Partners involvement as Administrative Agent indicates institutional backing from an experienced energy-focused investment firm

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• The automatic termination clause (February 7, 2025) creates time pressure for utilization of the unfunded commitment
• This represents the 19th amendment to the credit agreement, potentially indicating ongoing refinancing needs or covenant management issues
• Limited information available on pricing, maturity, or detailed covenant structure constrains full credit assessment
• Clean energy sector exposure may involve regulatory and commodity price risks
